sources.title: ATO: Key super rates and thresholds, employment termination payments
sources.fact: Reviewed by Ryan Duguid on 24 September 2026 (page last updated 17 April 2026): ETP cap: $270,000 for 2026-27, $260,000 for 2025-26, $245,000 for 2024-25. Genuine redundancy and early retirement tax-free limit: $13,598 plus $6,801 per complete year of service for 2026-27; $13,100 plus $6,552 for 2025-26; $12,524 plus $6,264 for 2024-25.
sources.limitations: Verify the complete page, applicable period and current status at use time.

sources.title: ATO: Applying the ETP caps
sources.fact: Reviewed by Ryan Duguid on 24 September 2026 (page last updated 24 July 2025): ETP cap applies to excluded payments (genuine redundancy and early retirement amounts over the tax-free limit, certain compensation, death benefits); the lesser of the ETP cap and the whole-of-income cap applies to non-excluded payments (golden handshakes, gratuities, non-genuine redundancy, payments in lieu of notice, unused sick leave or rostered days off). The ETP cap is reduced by earlier ETPs in the year and for the same termination; the whole-of-income cap by other taxable payments in the year.

sources.title: ATO: Schedule 11 tax table for employment termination payments
sources.fact: Reviewed by Ryan Duguid on 24 September 2026 (page last updated 17 June 2026): For 2026-27: ETP cap $270,000; whole-of-income cap $180,000. Life benefit ETP withholding up to the relevant cap: 32% under preservation age, 17% at or over it; 47% above the cap.
